Nice capture — quick notes from legal/ops side:

- We'll send a short NDA template immediately (same day) so ClearHealth can sign and unblock sharing of SOC2 evidence.
- For MSA redlines: ask Priya if she prefers our annotated MSA or a clean MSA for redline; if annotated is OK we'll highlight non-starters.
- Suggested routing: NDA -> initial MSA redline -> commercial (pricing) buffer -> final DPA (parallel with MSA finalization).
- Target turn-times we can commit to from Redwood legal: initial review of their redlines within 3 business days; if complex clauses surface, we propose a 2-round redline cadence (initial + final) to keep momentum.

Neha — can you prepare the security packet (SOC2 report stub, summary of controls, and DPA template) and upload to the shared Drive? I'll draft the NDA and the MSA cover note.
